boundaries.tools: owns follow_up plan schema and maps only product-authored scope into the public Scheduler SDK
boundaries.scheduler: owns trigger timing, plan revision and pause/resume; each occurrence is one bounded dispatch
boundaries.agent: owns strict report parsing, normalized change detection, terminal state and durable neutral event outbox
boundaries.runtime: owns the single SDK-to-SDK composition mapping and current Identity re-resolution
boundaries.notification: owns recipients, rendering, preferences, inbox, channels, delivery results and dedupe

forbidden_paths_checked: Agent application does not import Runtime, Scheduler, Notification or Tools implementation packages
Tools adapter does not import Agent, Scheduler or Notification implementation packages
Scheduler does not read Agent or Notification persistence
Agent does not implement a timer loop or Notification inbox
follow_up input cannot select owner, target, action, recipient, channel or provider
startup: Runtime auth and notification ports bind before Agent advertises the scheduled-task service; Runtime then binds that public service into its dispatcher
stop: the product Stop Follow-up action is Scheduler pause with revision CAS and remains paused after restart
